# Aspen Malibu Marketing — Full Reference

> Premium growth studio for ambitious operators. We build and run AI-powered revenue systems for local service businesses — not marketing campaigns, but profit machines that compound. Based in Aspen, Colorado and Malibu, California.

## Company Overview

Aspen Malibu Marketing is a premium growth studio for ambitious operators. We build and run the complete revenue engine — AI agents that book your calendar, ads that print customers, and funnels that convert while you sleep. You focus on delivery; we focus on growth.

We do not do marketing. We build profit machines — deliberately, with a quiet obsession for what compounds.

### Core Philosophy

**Systems over tactics.** Every campaign, every page, every automation feeds the next. Nothing exists in isolation. The result is compounding revenue — not one-off wins.

**AI + senior taste.** AI agents handle the volume; a small senior team handles the strategy. You get the throughput of a big shop with the taste of a boutique.

**Built to profit.** We onboard a small number of clients per quarter, by design. Premium time, premium outcomes — and a system that pays for itself inside 90 days.

### What We Do

We buy customers, not clicks. Every service is measured by one metric: revenue generated. Not impressions. Not likes. Real customers, real bookings, real profit.

Our portfolio has generated **$42.7M in client pipeline**, maintains **96% year-on-year client retention**, and averages **5.8× ROAS** across managed ad accounts. Standard clients go live in **14 days** and see their first lead within that window.

### Who We Serve

Trusted by ambitious operators across health, wealth, real estate, and lifestyle — including medical practices, med spas, wealth management firms, real estate brokerages, and home services companies.

### Location

Built in Aspen ✻ Malibu. We serve clients nationally across the United States.

## Services

### 01 — Search Engine Optimization

Show up where buyers are already searching. We turn organic traffic into a predictable revenue channel — not just rankings, but qualified leads that close.

- Local SEO that drives appointments
- Content that ranks AND converts
- Technical fixes for crawl budget
- Backlinks from real authority sites
- Monthly rank & revenue reporting

### 02 — Paid Ads Management

We buy customers, not clicks. Every dollar is tracked to revenue — not impressions. If an ad does not pay for itself in 30 days, we kill it and build a better one.

- Google & Meta ads optimized for ROAS
- TikTok & YouTube for scale
- Retargeting that recovers lost buyers
- Creative testing every 72 hours
- Forensic spend analysis included

**Ad management:** 15% of spend. No minimums. Google, Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

### 03 — Conversion Funnels

Traffic is worthless if it bounces. We architect pages, forms, and follow-up sequences that turn strangers into appointments — automatically, 24/7.

- High-converting landing pages
- Lead magnets your audience actually wants
- Email & SMS nurture that books calls
- A/B testing for constant lift
- Form optimization to reduce friction

### 04 — AI Automation

Your best employee never sleeps, never calls in sick, and costs less than minimum wage. AI agents handle voice, chat, content, and reviews — so your team closes deals.

- Voice AI that books while you sleep
- Chatbots that qualify before you call back
- Content AI that writes on-brand at scale
- Reviews AI that builds 5-star reputation
- Workflows that eliminate manual follow-up

### 05 — LLM / AI Search Discovery

SEO is no longer just Google. Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini who to trust. We engineer your brand into AI-generated answers before your competitors know it exists.

- Entity optimization for AI citations
- Structured data for LLM crawlability
- Authority signals AI engines trust
- Answer-engine content architecture
- Brand mention monitoring across AI platforms

## Process

From audit to profit in 14 days. A proven system designed to generate revenue fast — not just look good. Live in two weeks, cash-flow positive inside ninety days.

**Step 01 — Find the leaks.** Forensic audit of your funnel, ad accounts, and website. We find exactly where you are losing revenue — including hidden ad waste most agencies miss. You get a video breakdown — not a deck.

**Step 02 — Build the machine.** A high-converting site and funnel, wired into CRM, automation, and AI — so every visitor has a path to becoming a customer.

**Step 03 — Turn on the engine.** Voice AI answers every call. Chat AI qualifies every lead. Content AI ships daily. Reviews AI compounds your reputation. 24/7.

**Step 04 — Buy customers.** Paid ads optimized for profit, not vanity. SEO that compounds monthly. Every dollar is tracked to revenue — and tuned weekly.

**Step 05 — Scale the profit.** Live revenue dashboard, monthly strategy calls, and a system that gets more efficient every week. Forever.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How is this different from a traditional agency?**

Traditional agencies sell hours. We sell a system. A small senior team, leveraged by a custom AI agent stack, delivers senior-level taste with the throughput of a much bigger shop. The economics work for both of us.

**Can I really sign up for Growth Accelerator without a call?**

Yes — Tier 02 (Growth Accelerator) is the only self-service path. You select your revenue tier, submit your info, and we send the agreement and payment link within 2 business hours. You can always upgrade to Bespoke Service later.

**Why no fixed prices shown on the tier cards?**

Because Bespoke Service and Website builds are scoped to your business. The estimator uses our official rate card — you get the real number instantly, and we confirm it on a free 30-min call.

**How fast can we go live?**

Standard is 14 days from kickoff. Rush (7 days) is available as an add-on. Full ad campaigns and the AI agent stack roll out in the first 30 days.

**What's in the platform?**

CRM, pipeline, booking, email & SMS marketing, social scheduling, workflow automation, reputation management, real-time reporting, plus four AI layers — Conversation, Voice, Content, and Reviews. Everything talks to everything else.

**Do you handle paid ads?**

Yes — Google and Meta primarily, paid social where it converts. Ad management is 15% of spend. No minimums; you pay for what we run. Every Bespoke engagement includes a forensic ad account audit that finds hidden waste most agencies miss.

**What is the forensic ad audit?**

A deep, AI-powered analysis of your Google, Meta, and TikTok ad accounts. We connect read-only access and within minutes identify exactly where your budget is leaking — wasted keywords, poor targeting, overlap, and missed opportunities. It is available as a paid add-on for Growth Accelerator and included in every Bespoke engagement.

**What happens if I want to cancel?**

30 days written notice, 3-month minimum commitment. Your website and content are yours — we hand over the keys cleanly. No exit fees.

## Blog

### Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): The Complete 2026 Guide

**URL:** https://aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/generative-engine-optimization-guide

GEO is the practice of structuring your brand, content, and technical signals so large language models cite you when buyers ask who to trust. Covers entity foundation, structured data, answer-engine content, authority corroboration, and citation monitoring — the five-layer stack Aspen Malibu deploys as part of LLM / AI Search Discovery.

### How to Get Cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews

**URL:** https://aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/get-cited-in-ai-search

Practical citation architecture in seven steps: lock entity identity, publish answer-engine content, deploy llms.txt and schema markup, build corroborated authority, optimize for Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, and monitor citations over time.

### llms.txt, Schema.org, and OKF: A Technical Guide for AI Discoverability

**URL:** https://aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/llms-txt-schema-okf-guide

Technical walkthrough for the three layers of AI discoverability: llms.txt content prioritization, Schema.org JSON-LD entity vocabulary (Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, Article), and Open Knowledge Framework alignment across Wikidata, Google Knowledge Panel, and industry registries.

### Growth Marketing Retainer Cost in 2026: Real Pricing, No Guesswork

**URL:** https://aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/growth-marketing-retainer-cost

Published tiered pricing for Growth Accelerator ($997–$6,997+/mo) and Bespoke Service ($2,995–$20,995+/mo) by revenue tier, plus website pricing, add-ons, market comparison, ROI timeline, and transparency on what is not included.

### AI Voice Agents for Local Businesses: Answer Every Call, Book Every Lead

**URL:** https://aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/ai-voice-agents-local-business

How AI voice agents answer 100% of inbound calls 24/7, qualify leads, book appointments into CRM, and route emergencies to humans. Includes deployment process, industry fit, and comparison to traditional answering services.

### Growth Accelerator vs. Bespoke Service: Which Engagement Is Right for You?

**URL:** https://aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/self-service-vs-managed-marketing

Side-by-side comparison of self-service platform vs. fully managed revenue system — features, pricing, ideal fit, upgrade path, shared platform capabilities, honest boundaries, and a five-question decision framework.

### Meridian Health Partners Case Study: 312% Booking Increase in 90 Days
